seo.title: Logic2B Campings — your campsite's website and front desk, solved
seo.description: Software for campsites: a modern public website, a real booking engine and a front-desk manager in one system. Live in an afternoon. By Logic2B, Spain.

hero.titulo: Your campsite's website and front desk, in one system.
hero.subtitulo: A public website that sells on its own and a manager your front desk understands from day one. No spreadsheets, no double bookings, no portal keeping its commission.
hero.nota: A new campsite goes live in an afternoon. No lock-in to start.
hero.capturaWebAlt: A campsite's public website built with Logic2B Campings, with its availability search

problema.titulo: What's costing you money every August

puntos.texto: A form that lands in your inbox and a call the next day. Meanwhile the guest already booked somewhere else.
Booking takes its cut of every night. With direct bookings from your own site, that cut stays home.
A paper planner overlaps, gets erased, and only its author understands it. Moving a pitch is half an hour.
Answering in French, German and Dutch one by one. Your website should do that for you.

producto.subtitulo: The same information, without copying anything from one place to another.

bloques.texto: Fast, in six languages, with your photos and your brand. Guests search dates, see real availability and book —or leave a request— without leaving your domain. Built to be found on Google.
puntos: A real availability engine, not a mockup
Direct booking with no portal commission
bloques.capturaAlt: A campsite's public website home page with the date search

bloques.texto: Every unit at a glance, drag to reassign a pitch, take payment, see today's arrivals and departures, each guest's file and history. Built for the receptionist, not for an IT expert.
puntos: Visual planner with drag and drop
bloques.capturaAlt: The manager's planner with a month of bookings on screen

planning.titulo: The planner your front desk actually uses
planning.texto: Every unit, all summer, on one screen. Colours by status, blocks in plain sight, and reassigning a unit is dragging the booking —no cancelling, no charging again. Fast even with hundreds of pitches.
planning.cta: See it working in the demo
planning.capturaAlt: View of the planner with real bookings for a campsite in August
planning.planoAlt: The interactive campsite map with the state of each unit
puntos: Drag to reassign — no cancelling, no charging again
Colours by status and blocks in plain sight
Also as a map: every unit on your campsite's plan

niveles.subtitulo: One system, four levels. You move up by changing a setting, never by changing website or provider.

items.texto: A modern multi-language public website with a request form. Every request is stored: it's the history that makes you grow.
incluye: Your photos, your brand, your domain
SEO and speed taken care of

items.texto: Everything above plus a requests inbox and a light panel so you never lose an enquiry.
A real booking engine, online payments, and the full manager with the planner. Direct booking end to end.
incluye: Full planner with drag and drop

items.texto: The engine and manager wired into your current website. Custom, when you already have a site and only need the brain.

niveles.nota: Pricing tailored to your campsite. Ask us for a proposal.

alta.titulo: From zero to selling, in an afternoon
alta.texto: Send us your photos, your accommodation types and your rates, and we set up your instance. Your own database, your domain, your brand —isolated from any other campsite. No endless projects.

items.q: Do I have to change my domain?
items.a: No. Your site lives on your own domain, with your brand. We put the engine underneath.

items.q: What if I already use Booking?
items.a: You can keep it. Direct booking from your site saves you the commission on every reservation that comes in on your own; many campsites use both.

items.q: Is it hard for my receptionist?
items.a: It's designed for her: large screens, clear text, keyboard focus, and a planner you understand at a glance. No 200-page manual.
Each campsite has its own isolated database on Cloudflare's network. No other client can see your bookings.

items.q: How soon do I have it?
items.a: A new campsite goes live in an afternoon from your material. No months of waiting.

contacto.titulo: Ask for a demo with your campsite's data
contacto.texto: We'll show it with your inventory and your dates, so you see how yours would look —not a generic example.
contacto.ok: Got it! We'll write to you within 24 h.
contacto.error: Couldn't send. Email us at hola@logic2b.com and we'll sort it out.
contacto.verDemoTexto: Rather see it now? Enter the live demo with sample data.

footer.tagline: Software for campsites. Website + bookings + management, in one system.

seo.title: Logic2B Campings guides — front desk, management, owner and technical sheet
seo.description: How Logic2B Campings is used: the step-by-step front desk guide, the day-to-day management guide, the owner's guide to the four plans, and the technical sheet for your IT person.

docs.subtitulo: Four guides, four different people. Each one written for whoever will actually read it.
docs.fallback: This page is still in Spanish. We are translating the guides.
docs.ayuda: Can't find what you need? Write to hola@logic2b.com and we'll sort it out —and improve this guide while we're at it.

recepcion.para: For whoever is at the desk
recepcion.texto: The day-to-day of the software, task by task: log in, see who is arriving, check them in, take payment, move a booking on the planner and close the departure. No jargon.

gestion.texto: The management screens: read your business numbers in Reports, change the rates by season, file the guest register with SES.Hospedajes, and configure the campsite and its email alerts.

dueno.texto: The four Logic2B Campings plans explained as a ladder: what each one includes, what exactly changes when you move up, and what you need to provide.

tecnica.texto: How it is built: domains and DNS, outgoing email, per-campsite data isolation, GDPR, backups, and what happens if you ever want to leave.
